Stories discussed in this episode:

  • iOS 27 adds opt-in settings allowing data sharing to improve Apple's Foundation Models
  • T-Mobile to charge $5 per month for Apple's new iPhone Handoff feature
  • Craig Federighi responds to iPhone Duo and iPad product overlap concerns
  • iOS 27 officially released: New features, supported devices, and more
